page.overview:
Who is Ben Schatz?

The Streetcar Man 2 is a gay man and a friend of Waylon Smithers.

When Homer was talking to Waylon Smithers, a streetcar went past them with the streetcar man, another man, and Stuart on. He asked Smithers who "the bear", referring to Homer, was, then made a woof sound.

He was seen among a crowd of lesbian and gay couples being denied entry to the church by Reverend Lovejoy.

He was also seen in the crowd of gays during Moe's speech.
